alpacariboumysticalbeastoftheforest.name: Alpacaribou, Mystical Beast of the Forest
alpacariboumysticalbeastoftheforest.desc:
● While in Attack Position: Attack Position Winged Beast, Insect, and Plant-Type monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle.
● While in Defense Position: Defense Position Winged Beast, Insect, and Plant-Type monsters you control cannot be targeted by, or be destroyed by, card effects.

calloftheforgotten.name: Call of the Forgotten
calloftheforgotten.desc: When this card is activated: You can Set up to 3 "Call of the Haunted" from your Deck and/or GY, and if you do, until the end of your opponent's turn, you cannot Special Summon, except Zombie monsters, or monsters from the GY. Once per turn, if you activate "Call of the Haunted": You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; send it to the GY. You can only activate 1 "Call of the Forgotten" per turn.

clockwyvern.name: Clock Wyvern
clockwyvern.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can halve this card's ATK, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Clock Token" (Cyberse/WIND/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). You can only use this effect of "Clock Wyvern" once per turn.

darklorddesire.name: Darklord Desire
darklorddesire.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 Fairy-Type monster. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; this card loses exactly 1000 ATK, and if it does, send that target to the Graveyard.

elementalheroshiningneoswingman.name: Elemental HERO Shining Neos Wingman
elementalheroshiningneoswingman.desc:
"Elemental HERO Neos" + 1 "Wingman" Fusion Monster
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains 300 ATK for each monster in your GY, also cannot be destroyed by card effects. If this card is Special Summoned: You can destroy cards your opponent controls up to the number of different Attributes among the monsters on the field. You can only use this effect of "Elemental HERO Shining Neos Wingman" once per turn. If this card destroys a monster by battle: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original ATK.

evilswarmgolem.name: Evilswarm Golem
evilswarmgolem.desc: Once per turn: You can target 1 Level 5 or higher non-DARK monster on the field; destroy that target.

fusiondestiny.name: Fusion Destiny
fusiondestiny.desc: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck that lists a "Destiny HERO" monster as material, using monsters from your hand or Deck as Fusion Material, but destroy it during the End Phase of the next turn, also for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except DARK "HERO" monsters. You can only activate 1 "Fusion Destiny" per turn.

ggolemcrystalheart.name: G Golem Crystal Heart
ggolemcrystalheart.desc:
2 Cyberse monsters
You can target 1 EARTH Link Monster in your GY; Special Summon it to your zone this card points to, and if you do, place 1 GG Counter on this card. You can only use this effect of "G Golem Crystal Heart" once per turn. EARTH monsters co-linked to this card gain 600 ATK for each GG Counter on this card, can make a second attack during each Battle Phase, also if they attack a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

hitotsumegiant.name: Hitotsu-Me Giant
hitotsumegiant.desc: A one-eyed behemoth with thick, powerful arms made for delivering punishing blows.

ignisheatthetruedracowarrior.name: Ignis Heat, the True Dracowarrior
ignisheatthetruedracowarrior.desc: To Tribute Summon this card face-up, you can Tribute a Continuous Spell/Trap you control, instead of a monster. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect while you control this Tribute Summoned monster (Quick Effect): You can take 1 "True Draco" or "True King" Continuous Spell from your Deck, and either activate it or add it to your hand.

kaijucapturemission.name: Kaiju Capture Mission
kaijucapturemission.desc: Once per turn, if there are less than 3 Kaiju Counters on this card: You can target 1 "Kaiju" monster on the field; change it to face-down Defense Position, then place 1 Kaiju Counter on this card (max. 3). If this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card and sent to your Graveyard: You can draw 2 cards. You can only use this effect of "Kaiju Capture Mission" once per turn.

legendarywindupkey.name: Legendary Wind-Up Key
legendarywindupkey.desc: Change all face-up "Wind-Up" monsters you control to face-down Defense Position.

libromancerrealized.name: Libromancer Realized
libromancerrealized.desc: You can reveal 1 "Libromancer" Ritual Monster in your hand: Special Summon 1 "Fire Token" (Cyberse/FIRE/ATK 0/DEF 0) with the same Level as the revealed monster. While you control that Token, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except "Libromancer" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Libromancer Realized" once per turn.

lyriluscberylcanary.name: Lyrilusc - Beryl Canary
lyriluscberylcanary.desc:
If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 "Lyrilusc" monster in your GY; Special Summon both this card and that monster, also you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Xyz Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Lyrilusc - Beryl Canary" once per turn. A WIND Xyz Monster that was Summoned using this card on the field as material gains this effect.
● This card gains 200 ATK, also its control cannot switch.

onomatopaira.name: Onomatopaira
onomatopaira.desc:
You can only activate 1 "Onomatopaira" per turn. Send 1 card from your hand to the GY; add up to 2 of these monsters from your Deck to your hand (you cannot add 2 from the same category).
● 1 "Zubaba" monster
● 1 "Gagaga" monster
● 1 "Gogogo" monster
● 1 "Dododo" monster

prankkidsfansies.name: Prank-Kids Fansies
prankkidsfansies.desc: If this card is sent to the GY as material for the Fusion or Link Summon of a "Prank-Kids" monster: You can send 1 "Prank-Kids" card from your Deck to the GY, except "Prank-Kids Fansies", then you can Special Summon 1 "Prank-Kids" monster from your hand or Deck in Defense Position, except "Prank-Kids Fansies". You can only use this effect of "Prank-Kids Fansies" once per turn.

prometheuskingoftheshadows.name: Prometheus, King of the Shadows
prometheuskingoftheshadows.desc: If this card is Normal Summoned: Banish 1 or more DARK monsters from your GY, and if you do, this card gains 400 ATK for each, until the end of this turn.

satellarknightrigel.name: Satellarknight Rigel
satellarknightrigel.desc: If this card is Summoned: You can target 1 "tellarknight" monster on the field; it gains 500 ATK, but send it to the Graveyard during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Satellarknight Rigel" once per turn.

spikeshieldwithchain.name: Spikeshield with Chain
spikeshieldwithchain.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK. If the equipped monster attacks or is attacked while in Defense Position, it gains DEF equal to its ATK during damage calculation only.

stoicchallenge.name: Stoic Challenge
stoicchallenge.desc: You can only control 1 "Stoic Challenge". Equip only to a face-up Xyz Monster that has Xyz Material. It gains 600 ATK for each Xyz Material attached to a monster you control, and any battle damage your opponent takes from battles involving it and their monster is doubled, but its effects cannot be activated. During your opponent's End Phase: Send this card to the Graveyard. When this card leaves the field, destroy the equipped monster.

tenchikaimei.name: Tenchi Kaimei
tenchikaimei.desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Ninjitsu Art" card.)
When a "Ninja" monster you control inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it. If this face-up card in its owner's Field Zone has left the field because of an opponent's effect, and is now in the GY or banished: You can target any number of "Ninja" monsters with different names in your GY; Special Summon them in face-down Defense Position.

thesungodssteelcagelavagolem.name: The Sun God's Steelcage - Lava Golem
thesungodssteelcagelavagolem.desc:
1 "Sun God" monster you control + 2 face-up monsters on the field
Cannot be used as Fusion Material. Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) to your opponent's Main Monster Zone by sending the above cards from either field to the GY, but if you Special Summon this card with the second method, you can only Special Summon once for the rest of this turn. You can only Special Summon "The Sun God's Steelcage - Lava Golem" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage.

zodiacsign.name: Zodiac Sign
zodiacsign.desc: All "Zoodiac" monsters you control gain 300 ATK and DEF. Monsters your opponent controls cannot target face-up Beast-Warrior-Type monsters you control for attacks, except the Beast-Warrior-Type monster you control with the highest ATK (either, if tied). Once per turn, if a "Zoodiac" monster(s) you control would be destroyed by card effect, you can destroy 1 monster in your hand or field instead of 1 "Zoodiac" monster.
